status.caption: Status
status.relayArmHint: Contactor is off — Activate power to arm motor/VFD (UI confirm, then M42).
status.relayEstopPressed: E-stop is pressed — release before arming
status.relayConfirmArmBody: This closes the motor/VFD contactor. Confirm the machine is clear and safe first.
status.relayConfirmDisarmBody: This opens the contactor and stops all motion and spindle power through the relay.

configuration.caption: Configuration
configuration.title: nxt Configuration
configuration.toolSetterV2Hint: Fixed probe-reference pad on the toolsetter body. Calibration M5016 probes platen Z, then places the ref pad 13 mm from center and 6 mm below the activation plane.
configuration.toolSetterRefDirHint: Which side of the platen the V2.0 reference pad is on (Front / Back / Left / Right from the operator's view).
configuration.toolSetterRefPadPreview: {0}: ref pad ≈ [{1}, {2}, {3}] mm (Z from platen − 6 mm after M5016)
configuration.coolantMistPulseHint: Air blast stays on; mist output cycles on/off
configuration.coolantRelayReserved: Motor/VFD power is on the board relay pin (gpOut P5) — do not assign coolant or aux outputs that could energize the contactor via M7/M8.
configuration.atxMotorRelayInfo: Motor/VFD contactor uses gpOut P5 on PD_5. Enable the feature below, then arm/deactivate from Status (UI confirm → M42). Console M80.9/M81.9 still available. Not a Configuration picker and not hold-to-test.
configuration.featureMachinePowerHint: When enabled, Status can arm and disarm the motor/VFD contactor. Save Configuration to persist.
configuration.featureMachinePowerNeedHw: Required: Scylla relay (P5 / PD_5) or a Relay gpOut assignment.
configuration.featureMachinePowerReady: Relay hardware is configured — feature can be enabled.
configuration.outputGpHint: Select a named board pin (Mist, Coolant, Relay, Aux, …). Clear to unassign. Pins already used by another role are shown disabled.
configuration.outputRoleConflict: {role} already uses this pin — clear that role first, or pick another pin.
configuration.outputTestHint: Hold to turn the output on (M42 for gpOut, M106 for fan-mode pins); release to turn it off. Pointer is captured so leaving the button does not drop the OFF command.
configuration.boardFanPinsHint: Selected pins are created as M950 F (not gpOut). Default: Aux 0 (any motor voltage). Save + reboot/board pack reload required to recreate hardware.
configuration.boardFanPinsSaved: Fan pin list updated in OM — Save Configuration, then reboot (or reload board pack) for M950 to apply.
configuration.uartDeviceHint: Single primary device on the Scylla UART header (TX=PD8, RX=PD9). Further devices can daisy-chain on the same TX/RX later. Save + reboot to apply M575.
configuration.uartSaved: UART setting updated — Save Configuration, then reboot (or reload board pack) for M575.
configuration.customTravelHint: Required when Platform is Custom (XYZ). Optional A fields: fill a complete A set or leave A blank. Saved to nxt-user-vars.g; overlays go to 0:/sys/nxt-user-custom/ (survives plugin ZIP reinstall). Save also regenerates home*.g.
configuration.customEndstopsHint: Select one or more endstop pins per axis (order matches dual-drive order for M574 P"pin1+pin2"). Pins used by another axis are disabled. Min homes negative; Max homes positive. Overrides apply from nxt-user-custom after the board pack.
configuration.customDrivesHint: Physical drive indices per axis (colon-separated for dual drives). Overrides board M584 via nxt-user-custom/drives-overlay.g.
configuration.customDriveDirsEmpty: Map drives above to configure M569 direction per physical drive.
configuration.rgbLedCountHint: Number of NeoPixel LEDs on the strip (M950 U / M150 S). Save Configuration to persist. Reboot if the strip length does not update.
configuration.rgbTypeHint: M950 T: RGB (T1) or RGBW (T2). Wrong type on RGBW hardware causes rainbow / shifted colours.
configuration.rgbOrderHint: M950 K wire order. WS2812 NeoPixels usually need GRB (K5). Save Configuration to persist.
configuration.globalsSnapshotIntro: Expected nxt global variables from nxt.g / nxt-vars.g and their current values from the live RRF object model. Large vectors are summarized.
configuration.boardBootstrapHint: Bootstrap Auto: Save Configuration creates 0:/sys/nxt-board-bootstrap.requested so the pack loads after nxt-user-vars.g at boot. Bootstrap Off: Save removes that file. Use nxt-board-bootstrap.skip to hard-disable. Override with 0:/sys/nxt-user-board.g (see nxt-user-board.g.example).
configuration.boardMismatch: Board profile override does not match the primary board shortName from the object model. Clear the override to follow the machine, or verify wiring.
configuration.boardVoltageMissing: This board pack requires motor supply 24 V or 48 V. Choose a value below or set global nxtBoardMotorVoltage in nxt-user-vars.g.
configuration.boardNoKitsPlatform: No vendored kits for this platform yet.
configuration.boardPinmapHint: Optional file for M950 overrides; edit on SD or extend in a future UI release.
configuration.boardLoadOrderHint: Boot: nxt-vars → (Custom: nxt-custom-globals) → nxt-user-vars → board pack → nxt-boot → plugins → RGB → nxt-user-overrides (last) → nxtLoaded. Homing is deploy-only to 0:/sys/ — see docs/NXT_BOARD_HOMING.md.
configuration.boardHomingDocHint: Homing axis requirements per platform: docs/NXT_BOARD_HOMING.md
configuration.boardDeployConfirm: Overwrite on SD: {files} for platform {platform}? board.txt pin changes need a reboot.
configuration.boardDeployOnPlatformChange: Apply homing/sys files for platform {platform} now? Will overwrite: {files}
configuration.boardTxtRebootHint: Reboot required for 0:/sys/board.txt pin changes (serial.aux / RS485).

operatorFaces.hint: Relative to the operator at the front of the machine.

calibration.caption: Calibration
calibration.intro: Order when touch probe is on: tip radius → Phase 0 datum → load probe (G6511) → Phase 1 XY deflection (required) → Manual P2–P4 or Probe G9000→P3→optional P4 refine→re-check D → Phase 5 → Save. TR8×8 travel legs are 8/16/24 mm. Skip is only for P2/P3/P4 — not deflection.
calibration.probeCapabilityHint: Probe mode: XY deflection (M5017), G9000 travel backlash, dual-span M92, optional Phase 4 cluster refine from probe samples, verify. Not here: dial travel (Manual M5014), Z deflection (unused), A tip/D, machine-axis skew, or steps/mm from round-trip alone.
calibration.blockOrientation: Place the 1-2-3 block with the 3″ edge parallel to machine X, 2″ along Y, and 1″ as height (Z). Same orientation for A-axis work on the rotary.
calibration.needConnection: Connect to the machine to apply and save calibration.
calibration.phase0Hint: Touch probe is configured but reference location or nxtDeltaMachine is unset. Install a datum tool, run M5016 (toolsetter + reference surface with jog-confirm), Save the ref, then Enable Probe (raise to Z max + T…) so tpost can run G6511 height cycles (no location re-confirm).
calibration.phase0HintV2: Toolsetter V2.0 is enabled. Set the ref-pad side in Configuration (Front / Back / Left / Right), install a datum tool, and run M5016: probe the platen Z, then jog-confirm near the computed pad (13 mm from center, 6 mm below activation). Save the ref, then Enable Probe for G6511 height cycles.
calibration.phase0BlocksProbe: Datum (ref / delta) is still unset — recommended before G6511 height cycles and deflection. Probe mode is available once the probe tool is installed (Enable Probe).
calibration.readyHint: Check these before Enable Probe or re-running M5016. Red items block the action; amber is a warning (often incomplete datum).
calibration.readyBlockM5016: Cannot run M5016 until hard checklist items pass (features, configured touch/setter IDs, live toolsetter slot, axes homed, idle tool-change). Tip and probe tool are checked later for Enable Probe.
calibration.readyBlockEnableProbe: Cannot Enable Probe until tip sensor slot, probe tool, axes homed, idle tool-change, and ref/delta datum are ready (G6511 preflight).
calibration.readyTouchProbeIdOk: Touch probe sensor ID is configured
calibration.readyTouchProbeIdFail: Set nxtTouchProbeID in Configuration (required before M5016; tip not used until Enable Probe)
calibration.readyTouchProbeSlotOk: Touch probe sensor ID is a live probe slot
calibration.readyTouchProbeSlotFail: nxtTouchProbeID is not a configured sensors.probes slot (needed for Enable Probe / tip wait)
calibration.readyTouchProbeTypeOk: Touch probe sensor type is a touch input (5–8)
calibration.readyTouchProbeTypeFail: Touch probe sensor type is not a touch/probe input (need type 5–8)
calibration.readyToolSetterIdOk: Toolsetter sensor ID is a live probe slot
calibration.readyToolSetterIdFail: nxtToolSetterID missing or not a configured sensors.probes slot
calibration.readyToolSetterTypeOk: Toolsetter sensor type looks like a touch input (5–8)
calibration.readyToolSetterTypeFail: Toolsetter sensor type is unusual (expected type 5–8) — verify M558
calibration.readyProbeToolIdFail: nxtProbeToolID must be 49 — reboot or Save Configuration to normalize
calibration.readyProbeToolRowOk: Probe tool row exists in the tool table (M4000)
calibration.readyProbeToolRowFail: Probe tool row not defined yet — Enable Probe runs M4000 sync first; set tip radius in Configuration if sync skips
calibration.readyDatumG6511Fail: Datum incomplete for G6511 — nxtTouchProbeRefPos and nxtDeltaMachine must be set (finish M5016, then Save)
calibration.readyToolSetterPosFail: nxtToolSetterPos unset — run M5016 (or Save after datum)
calibration.readyProbeVirtualFail: nxtProbeVirtualTsZ unset — run M5016 / Save (or G6511 after probe load)
calibration.readyDeltaConsistencyOk: Delta matches ref Z − setter Z
calibration.readyDeltaConsistencyFail: Delta does not match ref Z − setter Z (manual edit / incomplete Save?)
calibration.readyToolChangeCancelledFail: nxtToolChangeCancelled is set — Clear with a successful T or set false after M999
calibration.readyToolChangeStateFail: nxtToolChangeState is mid-change — wait or M999 if status stuck Changing Tool
calibration.readyAxesHomedFail: Home all axes before M5016 / tool change
calibration.readyLiveSensorHint: Also press tip and platen: sensors.probes[K].value must cross threshold (globals alone are not enough)
calibration.datumSetupDone: Datum setup (M5016) finished — park and load probe, then Save
calibration.datumSetupIncomplete: M5016 did not complete (cancelled or never started). Confirm dialogs through the end; check console for aborts.
calibration.probeNotInstalled: Probe tool {0} is not installed. Raise to safe Z (machine max) then select it (Enable Probe) before probe-assisted moves.
calibration.probeModeHint: Complete Phase 1 deflection first (required). Then G9000 for travel backlash (not steps/mm), Phase 3 dual spans for M92, optional Phase 4 cluster refine, re-check D after M92, then Phase 5.
calibration.deflectionGateHint: Probe deflection is required when the touch probe is enabled. Complete Phase 1 (or confirm a non-zero saved value) before G9000, dual-span probe work, Save, or jobs (M4006).
calibration.deflectionRecheckHint: Steps/mm changed — re-check probe deflection (Phase 1) before Save is complete. Skip is not available for deflection.
calibration.confirmZeroDeflection: Factory-zero deflection is not calibrated. Complete Phase 1 before continuing — tip radius alone is not enough.
calibration.saveBlockedDeflection: Cannot Save: touch probe requires calibrated (non-zero) deflection and any post-M92 re-check. Open Phase 1.
calibration.phase4RequiredHint: XY deflection is required first — no Skip on this phase. Jobs abort via M4006 if D is unset or factory zero. Z deflection is unused.
calibration.axisANoLinearCal: A-axis has no linear tip/deflection or dual-span M92 path — use the rotary section for Y probes and manual A steps.
calibration.runG9000Confirm: Run G9000 on {0}? XY: from post-M5017 center, M5018 goes outside (O=15), probe-finds the − face, stays out (R0), then G9000 (no jog), then returns to saved center. Z still asks you to jog near a face. Estimates backlash only — use Phase 3 for steps/mm.
calibration.rotaryHint: Requires MosFourthAxis and a visible A axis. Keep the 1-2-3 block with 3″ parallel to machine X on the rotary. Use M4912/M4910/M4807; apply A steps via M4806 (not raw M92 A).
calibration.phase1Hint: Block: 3″∥X. Zero the dial, then away/return TR8×8 legs 8/16/24 mm (≤ ~25 mm dial stroke). Residual estimates backlash only — use Phase 3 for steps/mm. Skip OK if already done.
calibration.residualSignHint: Residual sign: + = short of zero after return (gap). measured = commanded − residual.
calibration.runMotionTestHint: Machine prompts: zero dial → away/return for 8, 16, 24 mm → enter residual each cycle. Results estimate M425 backlash only.
calibration.runMotionTestConfirm: Run M5014 on {0} (away dir {1})? Zero the dial when prompted, then enter residuals on the machine.
calibration.phase2Hint: Keep 3″∥X. Probe opposing faces for each nominal size; span = |right − left|. Constant offsets cancel in the span difference. Skip OK if steps already set.
calibration.phase2SpanHint: Probe left then right for size 1, then left/right for size 2. Spans compute automatically unless manual override is checked.
calibration.runG6512JogHint: Orient 1-2-3 with 3″∥X. Jog near the target face, then OK.
calibration.phase3Hint: Prefer G9000 (or Manual M5014) on a solid 1-2-3 face. Optional cluster refine: |mean+ − mean−| only when the same surface has free space on both approach sides — never through the block. Skip OK if backlash already set.
calibration.phase3ProbeHint: G9000 already estimated travel backlash. Optional refine: only add ± samples if you can probe the same face from opposite free-space directions (thin web). For a solid cube face, re-run G9000 instead of opposite-side approaches.
calibration.phase4Hint: XY from 1-2-3 (3″∥X / 2″∥Y) via M5017 or manual span. External: newD = currentD + (nominal − measured) / 2. Z deflection is not calibrated or applied.
calibration.phase4ProbeHint: Place the block with 3″ facing you (∥ X), 2″ ∥ Y. Jog to approx XY center at safe Z.
calibration.zDeflectionUnusedHint: Z deflection is not calibrated or applied — Z probes use the raw trigger. Phase 1 only sets X/Y (Z channel stays 0).
calibration.implausibleDeflectionHint: Proposed deflection is implausibly large (or tip radius looks like a diameter). Enter tip RADIUS (half the ball), re-run M5017, then Apply — do not bake tip error into D.
calibration.runM5017Confirm: 1-2-3 oriented 3″∥X / 2″∥Y? Jog to approx XY center at safe Z, then OK to run M5017.
calibration.phase5Hint: Re-check 1-2-3 faces (3″∥X), backlash, and repeatability. Save when satisfied.
calibration.phase2ProbeCaptureHint: Locked pose 3″∥X / 2″∥Y: from post-M5017 center, each button runs M5018 (raise → outside O=15 → dive → G6512 find edge → return to center) and stores nxtLastProbeResult. XY only — X uses 3″ ends, Y uses 2″ sides (no reorient required). Optional second size (L2/R2) only if you choose to reorient.

probingCycles.title: Probing Cycles
probingCycles.selectCycle: Select a probing cycle to configure and execute
probingCycles.touchProbeWarning: Touch probe feature must be enabled to use probing cycles.
probingCycles.selectProbeTool: Probe tool {0} is not installed. Enable Probe (raise to Z max + T…) before running cycles.
probingCycles.probeToolIdUnset: nxtProbeToolID is not configured — set the probe tool slot in Configuration.
probingCycles.depthHint: Drop only from current machine Z at Execute (mm). No park/raise — jog to start height first.
probingCycles.surfaceTravelHint: Max distance from the current jog toward the selected face (not a machine coordinate).
probingCycles.surfaceTravelRequired: Travel distance must be a positive number.
probingCycles.surfaceTargetHint: Absolute machine X or Y (M208 soft limits). Not WCS.
probingCycles.machineZUnavailable: Machine Z position unavailable — wait for OM update or home Z.
probingCycles.faceHint: Relative to the operator at the front of the machine.
probingCycles.approachClearanceHint: Outside air gap before contact with the face being probed. Default 5 mm.
probingCycles.cornerOffsetHint: Distance along each face from the corner before the first sample / Z dive.
probingCycles.faceLengthXHint: Approximate length of the X-normal face along Y, away from the corner.
probingCycles.faceLengthYHint: Approximate length of the Y-normal face along X, away from the corner.
probingCycles.faceLengthSHint: Approximate length along the face (perpendicular to the probe direction). Uses 3 points when long enough; 1 when shorter than 2× tip diameter.
probingCycles.faceLengthZDeferred: Z multi-point averaging is not implemented yet — one contact only.

workplaceOrigins.title: Work offsets
workplaceOrigins.caption: Machine G10 L2 origins (G54–G59.3). Editing the active WCS changes user position immediately; no move to X0 Y0. Rotation is the last probed skew (session-only).
workplaceOrigins.probe: Run configured probe cycle on this WCS
workplaceOrigins.probeNeedCycle: Select and configure a probe cycle first.
workplaceOrigins.clearConfirm: Zero {0} origins (X Y Z) and reset probe metadata? Probe results table is not cleared.

maintenance.caption: Maintenance
maintenance.idleEnable: Dim RGB and lower fan after inactivity

vfd.caption: VFD
vfd.intro: Select a VFD model and Apply to write arborctl-user-vars.g and run that driver’s config macro (enables Modbus control when CommReady is OK). Advanced Manual Modbus / Test Modbus tools stay in the ArborCTL plugin.
vfd.notInstalled: ArborCTL is not installed or loaded. Install the ArborCTL DWC plugin ZIP to configure VFDs here.
vfd.applyOk: Apply finished — check Comm chip and telemetry. Daemon will poll this driver when CommReady is OK.

toolManagement.caption: Tool Library
toolManagement.libraryIntro: Tools defined in the RepRapFirmware object model (configured slots, the tool in the spindle, and the configured touch probe). Magazine, job sequence, and ATC controls belong in the mos-atc plugin when installed.
toolManagement.persistenceHint: Save to board writes /sys/nxt-user-tools.g (M4000 + G10 L1). After each successful M4000 or M4001, the board also runs nxt-user-tools-sync.g to refresh that file unless you set global nxtAutoPersistTools = false in nxt-user-vars.g. Use Reload from SD after a manual SD edit. Boot loads this file after nxt-user-vars.g.
toolManagement.saveToBoardSuccess: Tool library saved to {path}. Restart the machine or tap Reload from SD to apply immediately.
toolManagement.reloadFromSdFailed: Failed to reload tool library from SD
toolManagement.lockedHint: Tool table is locked — unlock to add, edit, delete, or import tools.
toolManagement.indexProbeReserved: That index is reserved for the probe
toolManagement.importFusionHint: Choose an exported Fusion .tools file (ZIP with tools.json). Every pocket imports except the probe slot (typically T49).
toolManagement.importEmpty: No importable tools found in that file.
toolManagement.importSummary: Will import {kept} tool(s) (T0–T{max}; {skipped} skipped — usually only the probe).
toolManagement.noTools: No configured tools in the object model yet. Define tools in config.g / RRF tool table, or connect to the machine.

spindleControl.caption: Spindle Control
spindleControl.placeholder: Spindle control panel will be implemented in a future phase

rgbLight.caption: RGB Work Light
rgbLight.enableInConfiguration: Enable RGB Work Light in Configuration to control the machine light.
rgbLight.hardwareMissing: No LED strip in the object model yet. If the board pack set nxtRGBPin (Scylla does), controls still work after enabling RGB Work Light. Otherwise check board entry / M950.
rgbLight.statusColorsHint: Colors used by the daemon for each machine state. Apply pushes to the controller; Save writes nxt-rgb-colours.g. Test forces that state via nxtRGBTest.
rgbLight.statusStripHint: Click a status to show that colour. Edit colours on the nxt Status tab.

messages.chooseSubsection: Use Control in the side panel: nxt for Status, Configuration, and Probing; Tool Library lists configured RRF tools. Install the mos-atc plugin for magazine / ATC UI.
messages.menuMoved: nxt features are under Control: nxt (dashboard) and Tool Library (separate side item).
messages.toolLibraryInMenu: Tool Library has its own entry under Control in the side panel (same level as nxt).
messages.notReadyShort: nxt not loaded (global nxtLoaded is not true — see Configuration → nxt globals)
messages.restartMessage: nxt variables have not been loaded. The machine needs to be restarted to load the nxt system.
messages.restartWarning: This will restart the entire machine. Ensure the machine is in a safe state before proceeding.
messages.pluginUpdateHint: Before installing or upgrading the nxt ZIP in DWC Settings → Plugins, pause the daemon so the installer can replace open system files. After this release, routine updates usually only need a pause once when migrating from an older ZIP.
messages.pluginUpdatePaused: Daemon paused — install or update the nxt plugin ZIP now, then Resume (or reboot).
messages.probingComingSoon: Probing UI is under development. This panel provides minimal controls until the full probing UI is ported from the legacy implementation.
messages.basicProbeControls: Basic probe actions to interact with the machine from the UI.
